name: B10-0508/2025 (The Left) – Political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political situation in Myanmar including the humanitarian crisis of the Rohingya
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Myanmar's military rulers for seizing power and attacking civilians, including Rohingya people. It calls for the release of all political prisoners, including Aung San Suu Kyi, and says planned elections cannot be free or fair while violence continues. It asks the European Union to keep its arms embargo, give more humanitarian aid, and support efforts to hold the military accountable. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to keep its arms embargo and give more aid to Rohingya refugees.
- It calls on Bangladesh and other countries not to send Rohingya back to Myanmar now.
- It urges the UN Security Council to impose a global arms embargo on Myanmar.
